dicdir.description: Path to the system dictionary directory used by MeCab.

userdic.description: Path to a user-defined dictionary file. Leave empty to disable.

lattice_level.description: Lattice information level. 0 is standard, higher values provide more debug info.

nbest.description: Number of best results to output.

theta.description: Temperature parameter theta for probabilistic estimation.

cost_factor.description: Cost factor for the parsing model.

bos_format.description: Format string for Beginning Of Sentence marker.

eos_format.description: Format string for End Of Sentence marker.

node_format.description: Format string for each parsed node.

unk_feature.description: Features for unknown words, specified as a string.

dictionary_names.description: List of dictionary names to load from the system dicdir.
